title: NVIDIA announces financial results for first quarter fiscal 2027
publisher: NVIDIA Corporation via U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission
excerpt: NVIDIA reported Q1 fiscal 2027 revenue of USD 81.6 billion, Data Center revenue of USD 75.2 billion, 74.9% GAAP gross margin, and guided Q2 revenue to USD 91.0 billion plus or minus 2% with no China Data Center compute revenue assumed.
summary: The SEC-filed issuer release supplies current segment growth, normalized earnings, gross-margin, capital-return, and next-quarter guidance evidence for the scenario valuation.
